# Descriptions
@@ 1
Target has one of his mental stats (determine randomly) temporarily lowered by
d10. The temporary stat is lowered, not the potential. The mental stats are:
Presence, Empathy, Intuition, Memory, Reasoning, and Self Discipline. When the
duration expires, the stat will go back up by the same amount that it went
down (with a maximum of whatever the potential for the stat is).
@@ 2
Target is mentally bewildered. Each round, he has only a 50% chance of making
a decision. He will always defend himself from direct attack.
@@ 3
The target immediately loses 10% of his remaining power points (PPs). They may
be recovered normally (i.e., usually after a sleep period).
@@ 4
As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 2d10.
@@ 5
As Dull Mind I, except decrease affects a potential stat and the corresponding
temporary stat.
@@ 6
As Power Leak I, except decrease is 20%.
@@ 7
As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 3d10.
@@ 8
As Power Leak I, except decrease is 30%.
@@ 9
As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 4d10.
@@ 10
As Mind Erosion, except decrease is 2d10.
@@ 11
As Power Leak I, except decrease is 40%.
@@ 12
As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 5d10.
@@ 13
As Power Leak I, except decrease is 50%.
@@ 14
As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 6d10.
@@ 15
As Mind Erosion, except decrease is 3d10.
@@ 16
As Power Leak I, except decrease is 60%.
@@ 18
As Mind Erosion, except decrease is 4d10.
@@ 19
As Power Leak I, except decrease is 70%.
@@ 20
As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 8d10.
@@ 25
As Dull Mind I, except decrease is 10d10.
@@ 30
As Mind Erosion I, except decrease is 5d10.
@@ 50
As Mind Erosion I, except one mental stat is reduced to 1.
